Overview

This report evaluates the blowdown performance of segments BS01 — Export Compressor, Suction Scrubber, Aftercooler Train 2, BS02 — Export Compressor, Suction Scrubber, Aftercooler Train 1, BS03 — From 2nd Stage Recompressor, BS04 — 2nd Stage Recompressor, Suction Cooler and Scrubber, BS05 — 3rd Stage Recompressor, Suction Cooler and Scrubber Train 1, BS06 — 3rd Stage Recompressor, Suction Cooler and Scrubber Train 2, BS07 — Wet Gas Coolers, Glycol Contactor Scrubber, BS08 — Injection Compressor, Suction Cooler and Scrubber, BS09 — Injection Compressor to Gas Injection (turret), BS10&11, BS12 — Export Gas Backflow Meter and Heater, BS13 — Hot Crude Flushing Pump, BS14 — Test Separator, BS15 — 1st Stage Separator, BS16 — 2nd Stage Separator, BS17&19, BS18 — Glycol Contactor and Superheater, BS21 — Enclosed Volume Downstream Crude Heater, BS22 — Flowline Depressurisation from Turret, BS23 — Hot Crude/MEG from Turret, BS24 — 3rd Stage Separator, BS26 — Crude Pumps, Crude/Crude Exchanger, Crude Coolers, BS27 — 1st Stage Recompressor, Suction Cooler and Scrubber, BS28 — Crude/Crude Exchanger, Crude Heater on Skarv against simulated depressurisation curves, from a blowdown initiated at 01 Oct 2024, 13:51:06 (Europe/Oslo) (t = 0). The acceptance criterion is ±10% of each segment's own starting pressure (P0) around the theoretical curve (the measured curve must stay within the green bands throughout; the band width in barg is segment-specific).
